verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents its own review-before-publish flow. Changes become pull requests with per-PR preview URLs for reviewers, and the editor lets teams share changes and approve and merge pull requests before they reach the live site. Teammate review comments are not clearly evidenced: the only comment mention describes the AI agent leaving comments and suggestions, not human reviewers, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented human reviewer commenting/threaded discussion on proposed changes, required-approval or branch-protection controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.

support.subject: As a technical writer, teammates propose changes that go through review — comments, approvals, and a merge step — before they publish

citations.quote: Preview changes before they go live, share them with your team, and approve and merge pull requests from the editor.
Preview your changes before they reach your live site, then review and merge the pull request without leaving the editor.
Get unique preview URLs for each pull request so reviewers can see documentation changes in a live environment before merging to production.
